title.zh-TW: TUI 即時語音支援 WebRTC 協商
title.en: TUI Realtime Voice Supports WebRTC Negotiation

body.zh-TW:
改報告或查資料雙手正忙，想直接開口通話而不想切出視窗，現在待在 TUI（終端機文字操作介面）裡也能辦到。

新版為 TUI 裡的即時語音通話加入了 WebRTC（網頁即時通訊協定）協商功能，負責處理通話建立前的連線溝通。⟦好比兩個人約好在吵雜車站會合，以前只能靠文字傳訊慢慢喬，現在先對好語音頻道就能直接開口對話。⟧
body.en:
When your hands are busy editing a report or looking up information and you want to speak directly without switching windows, you can now stay right inside the TUI (terminal text interface).

This release adds WebRTC (a real-time web communication protocol) negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI, handling connection setup before a call starts. ⟦Think of two people meeting at a noisy train station: before, they had to coordinate slowly by text, whereas now they can agree on a voice channel first and speak directly.⟧

items.original: Added WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI. (#61172)

title.zh-TW: OpenTelemetry 匯出器自動更新驗證標頭
title.en: OpenTelemetry Exporters Automatically Refresh Authentication Headers

body.zh-TW: 給有串接 OpenTelemetry（開放式遙測資料標準）的開發者與管理者。新版為 OpenTelemetry HTTP 匯出器加入了自動更新驗證標頭的功能，不再一直沿用同一組舊的驗證資訊。⟦跟進出園區的通行 QR Code 一樣，以前得自己定期重開頁面領新條碼，現在手上的這張會自動換成最新版本。⟧
body.en: For developers and administrators who integrate OpenTelemetry (an observability data standard). This release adds automatic authentication header refreshes for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters instead of reusing the same old authentication details. ⟦Picture a campus entry QR code: previously you had to reopen the page periodically to get a new code, whereas now the one you hold updates to the latest version automatically.⟧

items.original: Added automatically refreshed authentication headers for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters. (#61028)

title.zh-TW: 不同環境可共用同名的 MCP 伺服器
title.en: Different Environments Can Share Identically Named MCP Servers

body.zh-TW:
你在測試環境和正式環境各自接了外部服務，卻因為兩邊的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器取了相同名字而打架嗎？

新版加入了實驗性支援，允許你在不同環境裡使用同名的 MCP 伺服器。⟦比方說家裡跟公司各有一間都叫「文件庫」的儲藏室，以前同名字會搞混，現在只要在不同場所就能各自掛上同樣的門牌。⟧
body.en:
Have you connected external services in both your test and production environments, only to have their MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) servers clash because they share the same name?

This release adds experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across different environments. ⟦Suppose both your home and your office have a storage room called "Documents": before, identical names caused confusion, whereas now they can share the same nameplate as long as they are in different places.⟧

items.original: Added experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across environments. (#60905)

title.zh-TW: 過大 WebSocket 請求改走 HTTP 備援
title.en: Oversized WebSocket Requests Fall Back to HTTP

body.zh-TW:
透過 WebSocket（維持長連線的通訊協定）送出的請求一旦太大，過去還會先做多餘的重試。

現在遇到過大的 WebSocket 請求，會直接改走 HTTP 備援通道，省去不必要的重試步驟。⟦就像寄送超重包裹，以前小貨車明明裝不下還得反覆試塞，現在當場直接轉交大貨車送走。⟧
body.en:
Previously, requests sent over WebSocket (a persistent-connection communication protocol) that were too large would still go through unnecessary retries first.

Now, oversized WebSocket requests fall back directly to HTTP, skipping unnecessary retry steps. ⟦Like shipping an overweight parcel, a small van used to keep trying to squeeze it in even when it clearly would not fit, whereas now the shipment goes straight to a larger truck on the spot.⟧

items.original: Oversized WebSocket requests now fall back to HTTP without unnecessary retries. (#60840, #60841)

title.zh-TW: 修好 MCP 登入登出或取消時的憑證衝突
title.en: Fixed MCP Credential Races During Login, Logout, or Cancellation

body.zh-TW: 幫外部工具授權帳號到一半想喊停，或是進行登入、登出，過去的 MCP 授權憑證容易發生衝突。這個問題已經修好，現在進行 OAuth（常見的帳號授權登入方式）取消、登入或登出，憑證不會再互搶。
body.en: Previously, MCP authorization credentials could conflict if you stopped partway through authorizing an external tool account, or while logging in or out. This issue is fixed, so credentials no longer race during OAuth (a standard account authorization method) cancellation, login, or logout.

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth credential races during cancellation, login, and logout. (#60849, #60981)

title.zh-TW: 雲端對話自動重連並保留恢復中的回合
title.en: Cloud Conversations Auto-Reconnect and Preserve Active Recovery Turns

body.zh-TW:
正盯著雲端對話等它把斷線前的進度接回來，最怕重連完那一輪操作卻沒留下來。

新版改善了雲端對話的自動重新連線表現，而且用戶端重新連上後，正在恢復中的回合會繼續保留。⟦像在線上看影片一樣，以前網路斷掉重連會漏掉緩衝到一半的片段，現在畫面接回來後，那一小段進度依然留著。⟧
body.en:
When watching a Cloud conversation wait to resume progress after a disconnect, the last thing you want is for that turn to disappear once it reconnects.

This release improves automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and keeps active recovery turns intact after clients reconnect. ⟦When streaming a video online, a disconnect used to drop the half-buffered segment upon reconnecting, whereas now that bit of progress stays intact once playback resumes.⟧

items.original: Improved automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and preserved active recovery turns when clients reconnect. (#60969, #61014)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 檔案替換與沙盒權限問題
title.en: Fixed Windows File Replacement and Sandbox Permission Issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上執行檔案替換，過去可能遇到異常而失敗，這個問題已經修好。

沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的安全隔離區）原本的權限設定，過去在 Windows 上可能會遺失，現在會完整保留。

執行期註冊資訊需要復原時，過去在 Windows 上會遇到的異常也已經修好。
body.en:
File replacement on Windows could previously fail due to an error, and this issue is now fixed.

Existing permissions for the sandbox (a security isolation zone that limits program access) could previously be lost on Windows, and they are now preserved.

Errors that previously occurred on Windows when runtime registration information needed recovery are also fixed.

items.original: Fixed Windows file replacement, sandbox permission preservation, and runtime registration recovery. (#60872, #60943, #60944)

title.zh-TW: 修正權限更新與子討論串遺失沙盒限制
title.en: Fixed Permission Updates and Child Threads Losing Sandbox Restrictions

body.zh-TW: 工作到一半臨時調整授權設定，或是從既有對話分岔出新任務繼續跑，原本套用的安全隔離過去可能會跟著失效。這個問題已經修好，現在更新權限或建立子討論串，既有的沙盒限制都會保留下來。
body.en: Previously, adjusting authorization settings mid-task or branching a new task from an existing conversation could cause the applied security isolation to stop taking effect. This issue is fixed, so existing sandbox restrictions are now preserved when updating permissions or creating child threads.

items.original: Fixed permission updates and child threads losing existing sandbox restrictions. (#60936, #61134)

title.zh-TW: 移除重複搜尋結果並修好含空白關鍵字摘要
title.en: Removed Duplicate Search Results and Fixed Snippets for Queries with Whitespace

body.zh-TW:
搜尋檔案的清單裡，過去同一個項目可能重複出現。新版已經移除重複的檔案搜尋結果，每個符合的檔案只會列出一筆。

用帶有空白字元的關鍵字搜尋討論串，過去跳出的搜尋結果摘要會顯示異常，這個問題也已經修好。
body.en:
Previously, the same item could appear more than once in file search results. This release removes duplicate file search results so each matching file is listed only once.

Searching threads with queries that contain whitespace previously caused malformed search result snippets, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original: Removed duplicate file search results and fixed thread search snippets for queries containing whitespace. (#60845, #60846)

title.zh-TW: 沙盒說明文件補上權限設定檔與檔案規則
title.en: Sandbox Documentation Updated with Permission Profiles and Filesystem Rules

body.zh-TW: 替工作環境規劃隔離邊界，卻不確定不同授權等級怎麼分、路徑存取又該怎麼限制，現在有清楚的官方指南可查。新版更新了沙盒說明文件，補齊權限設定檔與檔案系統規則的介紹。
body.en: If you are setting up isolation boundaries for your workspace and are unsure how authorization levels are divided or how path access should be restricted, there is now a clear official guide to check. This release updates the sandbox documentation with explanations of permission profiles and filesystem rules.

items.original: Updated sandbox documentation to explain permission profiles and filesystem rules. (#61133)

first_title.zh-TW: 本版未列出已驗證的重點更新
first_title.en: No verified highlights listed in this release

entries: Added split view to the Remote Control browser view, so you can keep several conversations open side by side: choose `Split Right` or `Split Down` from the `Split` submenu of a conversation's menu in the sidebar or of the ⋮ menu in its title bar (not available on phones).
Added Gemini 4 Neon (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) to `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

Added a scroll position indicator to the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: while you're scrolled up, the line above the prompt shows how much of the conversation is below what you're reading, such as `↓ 25 lines · 2 turns`.

Improved Markdown headings in agent responses and artifacts, which now show only their text, set apart by bold, italic, or underline, instead of starting with `##` to `######` markers that looked like Markdown that failed to render.

Improved `/fork` for conversations whose artifact folder has grown large, for example after the agent cloned a repository or kept build output in `scratch/`: the fork now leaves those files with the original conversation and points the forked agent to them instead of copying every file, so forking takes seconds instead of up to an hour, and deleting the original conversation also deletes those files.

Improved scrolling back through a long conversation in the Remote Control browser view: `Loading older messages…` now shows while earlier messages load, and if they fail to load, `Couldn't load older messages · Retry` lets you try again instead of the view retrying silently every time you scroll up.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it decides faster, times out less often, and asks you to approve safe commands less often: when the review runs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, it now uses medium instead of high thinking.

Fixed agent turns stopping with an error after a brief connection problem, such as a connection the server reset, a model response that broke off partway through, or the network not being ready yet right after your computer wakes from sleep; the CLI now retries these requests automatically.

Fixed Remote Control, `--remote-agent`, and voice dictation being offered when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, where they could only fail, for example with a Remote Control link that never connected: `--remote-control` and `--remote-agent` now exit with code 2 at launch, and `/remote-control`, `/voice`, and `/record` are left out of autocomplete and `/help` and explain that they aren't available with a Gemini API key.

Fixed the status line showing a red `AI: Out of credits` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY` and AI credits are turned on in your settings; API keys don't use AI credits, so that status and the `Use AI Credits` setting in `/config` no longer appear.

Fixed copying a long prompt with the mouse in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode putting a line break wherever the prompt wrapped on screen; a prompt you sent, or the text in the prompt box, now copies as you typed it.
Fixed bold text next to Chinese, Japanese, or Korean text showing its `**` markers when the bold part starts or ends with punctuation, such as `**注意：**这里`.

Fixed the Remote Control browser view crashing on a conversation that contains `@` mentions pasted back from a Markdown export, such as Google Docs' Copy as Markdown; such mentions now paste as plain text, and affected conversations open normally again.

Fixed pressing `Enter` in the Remote Control browser view sending your message while the send button was disabled, such as before an attachment finished uploading or while the conversation was still loading; `Enter` now waits until you can send, and your draft stays in the message box.

title.zh-TW: 自備金鑰新增 Gemini 4 Neon 模型
title.en: Add Gemini 4 Neon with your own key

body.zh-TW:
想測試不同的回答節奏，手邊又剛好用自己的 Gemini 金鑰在跑專案？

現在透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線時，清單裡多了 `Gemini 4 Neon` 可以挑選。只要在對話中輸入 `/model`，或在啟動時加上 `--model` 參數，就能選用 `Low`、`Medium`、`High` 或 `XHigh` 四種選項。⟦就像自己帶電池接上新入手的工具，開關從原本的單一模式，變成四段檔位任你切換，隨時照當下需要調整。⟧
body.en:
Want to test a different response style while running a project with your own Gemini key?

When you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `Gemini 4 Neon` now appears in the model list. Type `/model` in a conversation or pass `--model` at launch to pick `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, or `XHigh`. ⟦Think of bringing your own battery to power a new tool: instead of a single mode, you get four switchable settings to adjust whenever the task calls for it.⟧

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Neon (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) to `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

title.zh-TW: 自備金鑰隱藏不支援功能與點數紅字
title.en: Hide unsupported features and credit warnings on your own key

body.zh-TW:
拿 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線工作，以前畫面上常會冒出用不了的選項或警告。

使用這個金鑰時，Remote Control 遠端控制、`--remote-agent` 和語音聽寫原本都會失敗，像是產生的遠端連結永遠連不上。現在啟動 `--remote-control` 或 `--remote-agent` 會直接以代碼 2 結束。`/remote-control`、`/voice` 與 `/record` 也已從自動補齊和 `/help` 拿掉，並會說明無法搭配 Gemini API 金鑰使用。

先前若設定開啟了 AI 點數，畫面底部的狀態列還會出現紅色的 `AI: Out of credits` 警告。由於 API 金鑰不會扣 AI 點數，這則狀態提示連同 `/config` 裡的 `Use AI Credits` 選項現在都不再顯示。
body.en:
Working with a `GEMINI_API_KEY` used to surface options and warnings on screen that could not actually be used.

With this key, Remote Control, `--remote-agent`, and voice dictation would always fail—for example, producing a Remote Control link that never connected. Launching `--remote-control` or `--remote-agent` now exits right away with code 2. `/remote-control`, `/voice`, and `/record` are also left out of autocomplete and `/help`, and explain that they are not available with a Gemini API key.

Previously, if AI credits were turned on in your settings, the status line at the bottom would also show a red `AI: Out of credits` warning. Because API keys do not use AI credits, that status notice and the `Use AI Credits` option in `/config` no longer appear.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control, `--remote-agent`, and voice dictation being offered when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, where they could only fail, for example with a Remote Control link that never connected: `--remote-control` and `--remote-agent` now exit with code 2 at launch, and `/remote-control`, `/voice`, and `/record` are left out of autocomplete and `/help` and explain that they aren't available with a Gemini API key.
Fixed the status line showing a red `AI: Out of credits` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY` and AI credits are turned on in your settings; API keys don't use AI credits, so that status and the `Use AI Credits` setting in `/config` no longer appear.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 網頁版新增分割檢視
title.en: Add split view to Remote Control browser view

body.zh-TW:
想一邊盯著長簡報的修改進度，一邊在另一頭查資料，以前在瀏覽器裡一次只能看一段對話。現在開啟 Remote Control 瀏覽器畫面，就能同時並排開著好幾段對話。

只要從側邊欄的對話選單，或對話標題列的 `⋮` 選單打開 `Split` 子選單，挑選 `Split Right` 或 `Split Down` 就能分割畫面。不過手機上無法使用這個功能。⟦翻兩本參考書對照內容時，以前得合起這本再開那本；現在能把兩頁並排攤開，視線一移就能同時對照。⟧
body.en:
Want to keep an eye on a long presentation's edits while looking up notes on the side? Previously, you could only view one conversation at a time in the browser. Now you can open several conversations side by side in the Remote Control browser view.

Open the `Split` submenu from a conversation's menu in the sidebar or the `⋮` menu in its title bar, then choose `Split Right` or `Split Down` to split the view. This feature is not available on phones. ⟦Picture comparing two reference books: before, you had to close one to open the other, whereas now both pages lie open side by side for a quick glance back and forth.⟧

items.original: Added split view to the Remote Control browser view, so you can keep several conversations open side by side: choose `Split Right` or `Split Down` from the `Split` submenu of a conversation's menu in the sidebar or of the ⋮ menu in its title bar (not available on phones).

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 網頁版載入與輸入更穩定
title.en: Smoother loading and typing in Remote Control browser view

body.zh-TW:
在瀏覽器開著 Remote Control 翻紀錄或打字傳訊息，原本常遇到畫面沒反應、閃退或草稿提早飛出去的狀況。

在長對話往上滑看舊訊息時，讀取期間會顯示 `Loading older messages…`。萬一載入失敗，畫面會出現 `Couldn't load older messages · Retry` 讓你手動重試，不再每次往上捲就默默重試。

對話裡如果貼回從 Markdown 匯出（例如 Google Docs 的 Copy as Markdown）帶來的 `@` 提及，以前會害網頁整個閃退。現在這類提及會以純文字貼上，原本打不開的對話也能正常開啟。

附件還沒上傳完或對話仍在載入時，傳送按鈕明明還不能按，以前按下 `Enter` 卻會直接送出。現在 `Enter` 會等到可以傳送時才作用，你的草稿也會留在輸入框裡。
body.en:
Scrolling through history or typing messages in the Remote Control browser view used to run into unresponsive screens, crashes, or drafts sending too early.

When scrolling up through a long conversation, `Loading older messages…` now appears while earlier messages load. If loading fails, `Couldn't load older messages · Retry` lets you retry manually instead of silently retrying every time you scroll up.

Pasting `@` mentions back from a Markdown export (such as Google Docs' Copy as Markdown) used to crash the browser view. Those mentions now paste as plain text, and affected conversations open normally again.

Before an attachment finished uploading or while a conversation was still loading, pressing `Enter` used to send your message even though the send button was disabled. Now `Enter` waits until you can send, and your draft stays in the message box.

items.original:
Improved scrolling back through a long conversation in the Remote Control browser view: `Loading older messages…` now shows while earlier messages load, and if they fail to load, `Couldn't load older messages · Retry` lets you try again instead of the view retrying silently every time you scroll up.
Fixed the Remote Control browser view crashing on a conversation that contains `@` mentions pasted back from a Markdown export, such as Google Docs' Copy as Markdown; such mentions now paste as plain text, and affected conversations open normally again.
Fixed pressing `Enter` in the Remote Control browser view sending your message while the send button was disabled, such as before an attachment finished uploading or while the conversation was still loading; `Enter` now waits until you can send, and your draft stays in the message box.

title.zh-TW: altscreen 全螢幕新增捲動剩餘提示
title.en: Scroll progress indicator for altscreen full screen

body.zh-TW:
在長對話裡回頭找早先寫好的內容，滑太遠常常搞不清楚自己離最新回覆還差多遠。

切換到 `full screen (altscreen)` 全螢幕模式後，往上捲動閱讀舊內容時，輸入框上方會多出一行進度。那裡會標出目前位置底下還剩多少對話，例如 `↓ 25 lines · 2 turns`。⟦跟在通訊群組往上爬舊訊息一樣，以前翻到一半常會忘了底下還有多少則新留言；現在畫面多出這行提醒，一眼就抓得出還要往下滑多遠。⟧
body.en:
When scrolling way back in a long conversation to find earlier work, it is easy to lose track of how far you are from the latest reply.

In `full screen (altscreen)` mode, scrolling up to read older messages now shows a progress line above the prompt. It displays how much of the conversation sits below your current spot, such as `↓ 25 lines · 2 turns`. ⟦Like scrolling up through an old group chat, it is easy to forget how many new replies are waiting below; this reminder line lets you see at a glance how far down you still need to go.⟧

items.original: Added a scroll position indicator to the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: while you're scrolled up, the line above the prompt shows how much of the conversation is below what you're reading, such as `↓ 25 lines · 2 turns`.

title.zh-TW: 修正 altscreen 複製長提示詞多出斷行
title.en: Fix extra line breaks when copying long prompts in altscreen

body.zh-TW: 想把打了好幾行的提問從畫面上抄下來改寫，貼到別處卻變得支離破碎、每行都被截斷。這是因為過去在 `full screen (altscreen)` 全螢幕模式用滑鼠選取複製時，文字在螢幕上折行的位置會被插進換行。這個問題已經修好，現在不論複製已送出的提示詞或輸入框裡的文字，都會照你原本打的樣子完整複製。
body.en: Copying a multi-line prompt off the screen to revise it used to paste back fragmented, with every line cut off. That happened because selecting and copying with the mouse in `full screen (altscreen)` mode inserted line breaks wherever text wrapped on screen. This issue is fixed, so copying either a sent prompt or text in the prompt box now preserves it exactly as you typed it.

items.original: Fixed copying a long prompt with the mouse in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode putting a line break wherever the prompt wrapped on screen; a prompt you sent, or the text in the prompt box, now copies as you typed it.

title.zh-TW: /fork 對大型產物資料夾改用指向不複製
title.en: /fork now points to large artifact folders instead of copying

body.zh-TW:
對話進行到一半，資料夾裡塞滿了專案程式碼或留在 `scratch/` 的建置檔，想用 `/fork` 分出一條新分支往往得枯等好久。

現在 `/fork` 遇到龐大的產物資料夾，不會再把每個檔案複製一遍，而是把檔案留在原本的對話裡，讓分支出去的 AI 代理直接指向原處。這項改動讓分支幾秒鐘就能完成，不必再像從前最多等上一小時，不過刪掉原本的對話時，這些檔案也會一起刪掉。⟦開新分店不用把總部整座倉庫的樣品全重買一遍，新店只留一張調貨地址條直接去原倉看貨；只是總部哪天把該倉庫撤掉，那些樣品也會跟著清空。⟧
body.en:
Midway through a conversation, if its folder is packed with project code or build files left in `scratch/`, running `/fork` to start a new branch used to mean a long wait.

Now, when `/fork` encounters a large artifact folder, it leaves those files in the original conversation and points the forked AI agent directly to them instead of copying every file. This lets forking finish in seconds rather than waiting up to an hour, though deleting the original conversation also deletes those files. ⟦Opening a new branch store no longer means buying a duplicate set of every sample in headquarters' warehouse: the new shop just keeps a forwarding address to inspect the original stock, though closing that main warehouse clears out those samples too.⟧

items.original: Improved `/fork` for conversations whose artifact folder has grown large, for example after the agent cloned a repository or kept build output in `scratch/`: the fork now leaves those files with the original conversation and points the forked agent to them instead of copying every file, so forking takes seconds instead of up to an hour, and deleting the original conversation also deletes those files.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式審核沙盒外指令變快也少打擾
title.en: Faster, quieter Auto mode reviews outside the sandbox

body.zh-TW:
放手讓工具自己執行任務，卻因為一條安全指令被卡在權限確認畫面，工作節奏一下就被打斷。

過去 Auto 模式要審核會離開終端機沙盒（限制程式活動範圍的隔離環境）的指令時，不只等得久，還常跳出詢問。現在只要這道審核是在 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 上執行，就會從高等改用中等思考，判斷更快、比較不會逾時，也更少為了安全指令要你點同意。⟦銀行櫃員核對轉帳單時，以前每一筆都拿放大鏡反覆端詳半天；現在改成看清關鍵欄位就蓋章，不但放行更快，也比較不會動不動就叫本人簽名確認。⟧
body.en:
Letting the tool run tasks on its own only to get stalled on a permission prompt for a safe command quickly breaks your flow.

Previously, when Auto mode reviewed commands that would leave the terminal sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts where programs can act), it took a long time and often popped up approval prompts. Now, whenever that review runs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, it uses medium instead of high thinking, deciding faster, timing out less often, and asking you to approve safe commands less often. ⟦A bank teller checking transfer slips used to examine every line with a magnifying glass; now they verify the key fields and stamp it right away, clearing transfers faster and asking for an in-person signature far less often.⟧

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it decides faster, times out less often, and asks you to approve safe commands less often: when the review runs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, it now uses medium instead of high thinking.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 標題與粗體不再露出原始符號
title.en: Markdown headings and bold text no longer show raw markers

body.zh-TW:
閱讀 AI 寫好的筆記或長文，畫面上突然冒出沒轉換成功的井字號或星號，總讓人以為排版壞掉了。

AI 回覆與產物裡的 Markdown 標題，以前開頭會直接印出 `##` 到 `######` 符號，看起來像語法沒套用成功。現在標題只會顯示文字本體，改用粗體、斜體或底線來區分層級。

在中日韓文字旁邊使用粗體，若粗體開頭或結尾帶著標點符號，像是 `**注意：**这里`，過去會把 `**` 原封不動顯示出來。這項顯示問題現在已經修好，粗體文字會正常套用。⟦跟排版師校對完的書稿一樣，原本留在頁面上的記號與框線全都收乾淨，只留下大小粗細分明的正式文字。⟧
body.en:
Reading notes or long drafts written by AI only to see unconverted hash marks or asterisks pop up makes the layout look broken.

Markdown headings in AI responses and artifacts used to print `##` to `######` markers at the start, looking like syntax that failed to render. Now headings show only their text, using bold, italic, or underline to set levels apart.

Next to Chinese, Japanese, or Korean text, bold text that started or ended with punctuation—such as `**注意：**这里`—used to display the `**` markers as raw text. That display bug is now fixed, and bold formatting applies properly. ⟦Just like a manuscript after a typesetter finishes proofing, all the leftover markup symbols and guidelines vanish from the page, leaving only clean, properly weighted text.⟧

items.original:
Improved Markdown headings in agent responses and artifacts, which now show only their text, set apart by bold, italic, or underline, instead of starting with `##` to `######` markers that looked like Markdown that failed to render.
Fixed bold text next to Chinese, Japanese, or Korean text showing its `**` markers when the bold part starts or ends with punctuation, such as `**注意：**这里`.

title.zh-TW: 修正短暫斷線或喚醒時任務直接報錯中斷
title.en: Fix turn errors on brief disconnects or wake from sleep

body.zh-TW: 剛掀開筆電蓋子想繼續對話，或是模型回答寫到一半網路突然閃了一下，眼看進度就要整個作廢。過去遇到電腦剛從睡眠喚醒網路還沒就緒、伺服器重設連線，或模型回覆中途斷掉，當輪任務會直接報錯停擺。這個問題已經修好，現在指令列工具會自動重試這些請求。
body.en: Flipping open your laptop to continue a conversation or hitting a brief network blip mid-response used to put your progress at risk. Previously, when your computer had just woken from sleep and the network was not ready yet, the server reset the connection, or a model response broke off partway through, the current turn stopped with an error. That is fixed—the CLI now retries these requests automatically.

items.original: Fixed agent turns stopping with an error after a brief connection problem, such as a connection the server reset, a model response that broke off partway through, or the network not being ready yet right after your computer wakes from sleep; the CLI now retries these requests automatically.

body.zh-TW: 列表中同時留著好幾條舊紀錄，想替其中一條換個好認的標記，卻不想一一打開。現在選好目標後輸入 `/rename`，就能直接把那個工作階段改名，不用先打開它。⟦就像站在書架前替書換書腰，以前得先把整本書抽出來翻過才能改名，現在不用打開內頁就能直接寫上新名字。⟧

title.zh-TW: 新增 /models 指令從伺服器重抓模型清單
title.en: New /models command refreshes the model list from the server

body.zh-TW: 不確定畫面上顯示的模型還是不是最新一批，卻不想靠猜的。輸入 `/models`，就會直接向伺服器重新抓取目前可用的模型清單。⟦跟走到自動販賣機前按下更新鍵一樣，不用憑印象猜測，直接向倉庫抓回最新上架的品項清單。⟧
body.en: You are not sure whether the models shown on screen are still the latest batch, and you do not want to guess. Entering `/models` fetches the currently available model list directly from the server again. ⟦Think of walking up to a vending machine and pressing a refresh button: instead of guessing from memory, you pull the latest stocked item list straight from the warehouse.⟧

title.en: /hooks list now shows file names and settings in clear fields

body.zh-TW: 查看自動化設定不用再對著原始指令硬猜用途。`/hooks` 清單每一列現在都會顯示 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）的檔案名稱。各項設定也改成在易讀的欄位裡列出，不再直接傾倒原始指令。⟦配電箱打開來，以前裡面只塞著一長串難懂的原始線路代號，現在每個開關旁都印好檔名跟設定項目。⟧
body.en: Checking your automation setup no longer means guessing what raw commands do. Each row in the `/hooks` list now displays the file name of the hook (a small program triggered by a specific event). Settings are also listed in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands. ⟦Open a breaker box: before, it was stuffed with a long string of cryptic raw wiring codes, and now each switch has its file name and settings printed right beside it.⟧

items.original: `/hooks` rows now show the hook file name and list settings in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器檢視與開關設定更準確
title.en: More accurate MCP server inspection and toggle behavior

body.zh-TW:
調整或檢查 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，現在能看到更清楚的狀態與路徑。

在 `/mcps` 裡，除非裡頭超過十台伺服器，否則代管區塊預設會直接展開。

在已經執行的終端機介面工作階段裡，`grok mcp disable` 與 `grok mcp enable` 現在能正確停止對應的伺服器。

執行 `grok inspect` 檢查專案自訂的 MCP 伺服器時，回報的設定檔位置現在能正確對應到 `.grok/config.toml` 或 `.mcp.json`。

這樣一來，清單展開範圍、進行中工作階段的伺服器停用，以及設定檔路徑都跟實際狀態一致。
body.en:
When adjusting or checking MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers, you now see clearer statuses and paths.

In `/mcps`, hosted sections are now expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers.

Inside already-running terminal UI sessions, `grok mcp disable` and `grok mcp enable` now properly stop the corresponding servers.

When running `grok inspect` on project-defined MCP servers, the reported config file location now accurately points to `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json`.

As a result, list expansion scope, stopping servers in active sessions, and config file paths all match the actual state.

items.original:
`/mcps` now shows hosted sections expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers
`grok mcp disable` (and enable) now correctly stops servers inside already-running TUI sessions
`grok inspect` now reports the correct project `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json` file for project-defined MCP servers

title.en: Pressing Enter in /workflows opens the file for viewing and searching

body.en: When reviewing workflow definitions, you often need to check how the steps are written. Now, pressing `Enter` on an item in the `/workflows` list opens that workflow's file directly so you can browse and search its contents.

items.original: Enter on a workflow in the `/workflows` list now opens its file for viewing and searching

title.zh-TW: 全展開模式重複收合思考時會提示關閉快捷鍵
title.en: Hint shows the toggle shortcut when repeatedly collapsing thoughts in expand-all mode

body.zh-TW: 每次回答一長串思考過程，你可能忍不住一塊一塊手動把它們摺起來，卻忘了全部展開模式還開著。在全部展開開啟的狀態下，只要你持續把思考段落一個個收起來，畫面就會跳出提示，列出用來關掉全部展開的組合鍵。⟦你一盞一盞手動關掉小燈，旁邊的人看你連按好幾顆，就會順手指給你看總開關的位置在哪。⟧
body.en: When a response includes a long chain of thought steps, you might find yourself folding them up one by one without realizing expand-all mode is still on. While expand-all is enabled, if you keep collapsing thought sections individually, a hint appears showing the key chord that turns expand-all off. ⟦As you switch off small lights one by one, someone watching you press several switches in a row points out where the master switch is.⟧

items.original: A new contextual hint appears when you keep collapsing thoughts while expand-all is on, showing the chord that turns it off

title.zh-TW: 問答卡打字與貼上回答不再誤觸快捷鍵或捲過頭
title.en: Typing and pasting on question cards no longer trigger shortcuts or overscroll

body.zh-TW:
在問答卡上想填寫自己的回答，以前操作常出狀況。現在打字或貼上回答內容，都不會再被誤認成快捷鍵。

打字輸入回答的過程中，問答卡清單也不會再捲超過最後一個選項。
body.en:
Entering your own answer on a question card used to run into input issues. Now, typing or pasting an answer is no longer misinterpreted as a shortcut.

While typing an answer, the question card list also no longer scrolls past the last option.

items.original:
Typed or pasted answers on question cards are no longer misinterpreted as shortcuts
Question card lists no longer scroll past the last option while typing an answer

title.zh-TW: 儀表板派送與快速檢視回覆框操作改進
title.en: Improved controls in dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes

body.zh-TW:
打字打一半想一口氣清掉剛敲錯的字詞，不用再連按倒退鍵。現在在儀表板的派送與快速檢視回覆框裡按 `Ctrl+W`，就能刪掉前一個單字。

當派送訊息正在等待圖片傳送時，快速檢視回覆框依然可以正常接收按鍵輸入與貼上內容。
body.en:
When you want to clear a mistyped word mid-sentence, you no longer need to tap backspace repeatedly. Pressing `Ctrl+W` in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes now deletes the previous word.

While a dispatch message is waiting on an image transfer, the peek reply box still accepts keystrokes and pasted content normally.

items.original:
Ctrl+W now deletes the previous word in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes
Dashboard peek still accepts keys and pastes while a dispatch send waits on an image

title.zh-TW: 接續工作階段後背景任務與工作流程位置修正
title.en: Fixed placement of background tasks and workflows after resuming a session

body.zh-TW: 事情做到一半暫停，回頭重開紀錄繼續進行，裡頭有些項目常會插錯順序。這個問題已經修好，現在重開工作階段後，背景任務與工作流程都會出現在對話紀錄裡正確的順序位置。
body.en: When you paused halfway through a task and reopened the record to continue, some items would end up out of order. That issue is fixed: after resuming a session, background tasks and workflows now appear in the right order in the transcript.

items.original: Background tasks and workflows now appear in the correct place in the transcript after resuming a session

title.zh-TW: 搜尋與篩選列的選取錯位與語法錯誤提示修正
title.en: Fixed selection offset and syntax error message in search and filter bars

body.zh-TW:
在區塊檢視器裡用搜尋列找內容，以前容易點選到被搜尋列蓋住的那一行。現在搜尋列不會再誤選被它擋在底下的那行文字。

當輸入的 regex（正規表達式，用符號匹配字串的語法）格式無效時，搜尋列與篩選列現在會直接顯示 `bad pattern`。
body.en:
When searching in the block viewer, it used to be easy to select the line covered by the search bar. The search bar no longer mistakenly selects the line of text hidden underneath it.

When an invalid regex (regular expression, a syntax for matching strings with symbols) is entered, the search and filter bars now directly display `bad pattern`.

items.original:
Block viewer search bar no longer selects the line hidden under it
Search and filter bars now show `bad pattern` when the regex is invalid

title.zh-TW: 回覆中的無效連結改顯示為純文字
title.en: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text

body.zh-TW: 回覆裡有時會夾帶已經失效的連結，過去畫面還是把它畫成可點擊的超連結。現在回覆中的無效連結只會以純文字呈現，不會再顯示為可點擊的連結。
body.en: Replies sometimes include dead links, which the screen used to render as clickable hyperlinks. Now dead links in replies appear only as plain text rather than clickable links.

items.original: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text rather than clickable links

body.en: When checking phase timing after using `/goal pause`, the screen used to keep showing stale time. Now phase timers after `/goal pause` start from zero and no longer display leftover old time.

items.original: Phase timers after `/goal pause` now start from zero instead of showing stale time

title.zh-TW: grok update 輸出不再夾帶內部代號與設定檔
title.en: grok update output no longer includes internal IDs or config files

body.zh-TW: 更新完工具想確認畫面訊息，以前總會混進幾行給研發端看的編號和檔名。現在 `grok update` 的輸出已經移除這些內部項目，不再顯示實驗 ID 或設定檔名稱。
body.en: When checking screen messages after updating the tool, a few lines of IDs and filenames meant for developers used to get mixed in. Now `grok update` has removed these internal items from its output and no longer displays experiment IDs or config file names.

items.original: `grok update` no longer mentions internal experiment IDs or config files in its output

title.zh-TW: 登入畫面貼上金鑰時不再點名環境變數
title.en: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when pasting a key

body.zh-TW: 把存好的通行憑證複製進帳號驗證框，以前頁面還會順帶寫出一個系統參數的名字。現在當你可能貼上了已儲存的金鑰，登入畫面不再顯示環境變數名稱。
body.en: When copying a saved credential into the account verification box, the page used to also mention the name of a system parameter. Now when you may have pasted a saved key, the sign-in screen no longer displays an environment variable name.

items.original: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when a saved key may have been pasted

title.zh-TW: 服務端連上卻不回傳時對話與壓縮不再卡死
title.en: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects without responding

body.en: During conversation turns or content compaction, if a provider established a connection but never sent back a response, the screen used to freeze. This issue is now fixed, so when a provider connects without responding, neither turns nor conversation compaction will hang anymore.

items.original: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects but never sends a response

title.zh-TW: 不支援看圖的模型讀到圖片不再中斷
title.en: Models that cannot view images no longer break when reading images

body.zh-TW:
手邊用的是不能辨識圖片的模型，以前碰到圖片會讓整個工作階段直接中斷。現在不論讀取圖片檔，或從 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取得圖片，工作階段都不會再中斷，結果裡只會註明圖片沒有附上。

⟦跟只收純文字的舊款呼叫器一樣，以前收到照片會整台當機，現在只會顯示圖片沒附上，連線不會中斷。⟧
body.en:
If you are using a model that cannot recognize images, encountering an image used to break the entire session. Now, whether you read an image file or get an image from an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool, the session no longer breaks, and the result simply notes that the image was not attached.

⟦Like an old text-only pager that used to crash completely when receiving a photo, it now just shows that the image was not attached without dropping the connection.⟧

items.original: Reading an image file or getting an image from an MCP tool no longer breaks the session on a model that cannot view images; the result says the image was not attached

title.zh-TW: 編輯器內的代理工作階段無法存檔會跳警告

body.zh-TW: 你跟 AI 互動到一半，如果這段紀錄沒辦法繼續存下來，以前不會收到任何提示。現在只要工作階段無法再存檔，編輯器就會發出警告。
body.en: If you were in the middle of interacting with AI and the session could no longer be saved, you used to receive no notice. Now, whenever the session can no longer be saved, the editor shows a warning.

items.original: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

title.en: muse exec with JSON also numbers attached images

body.en: Previously, running `muse exec --json --image` to include images did not number them in the prompt. Now, matching `muse exec --image` without `--json`, it labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt.

title.zh-TW: 短句開頭的非英文回答不再被丟棄重寫

body.zh-TW:
第一則訊息只打幾個字，原本會讓法文、西班牙文、德文等外語回覆整個作廢重來。現在這些非英文回答都會留住。Muse 只會在你的訊息使用常見英文單字，或你主動要求用英文時，才會把工作階段語言設成英文。

⟦好比手機自動切換輸入法，以前開頭打太短就會把剛寫好的外語整段刪掉換成英文，現在除非出現常見英文詞或你主動要求，否則不會擅自換語言。⟧
body.en:
Typing just a few words in your first message used to cause replies in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages to be discarded and rewritten. Now those non-English answers are kept. Muse only sets the session language to English when your messages use common English words or when you ask for English.

⟦Picture a phone that auto-switches keyboards: previously, a short opening message would wipe out the foreign-language text you just wrote and replace it with English, whereas now it will not switch languages on its own unless common English words appear or you ask for it.⟧

items.original: Answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short; Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you ask for English

title.zh-TW: 壓縮完的工作階段不再回頭重讀全部紀錄
title.en: Compacted sessions no longer re-read their entire log

body.zh-TW: 工作階段剛做完壓縮，以前還會在背景把整份工作階段紀錄從頭再讀過。現在壓縮結束後，這項背景重讀已經取消。
body.en: Right after a session compacted, it used to re-read the entire session log from the beginning in the background. Now, once compaction finishes, that background re-read has been canceled.

items.original: A session that has compacted no longer re-reads its whole session log in the background after a compaction

first_title.zh-TW: Agent 遇阻回報與建置除錯流程改進
first_title.en: Improved Agent Blocker Reporting and Build Debugging

entries: **Antigravity days in the snapshot now show the corrected token totals.** Before this fix, the daily snapshot replaced a saved day only if the new total was at least as large. Antigravity days saved before the token-counting fix were too high, so the smaller corrected totals never replaced them, in reports or in the snapshot file. The snapshot now records which counting version produced each day. It replaces an old Antigravity day only when every session and every other tool's records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger updates that day only after the snapshot has replaced it, and reports no longer add the old difference back from the ledger.

**CSV exports no longer drop the 10th project when old total-only records exist.** The project CSV export took the top 10 rows first and set aside old total-only records second. Those records took one of the 10 places, so the 10th project was left out. The export now sets aside old total-only records first and then takes the top 10 projects, the same way the report chart does. The old records get their own row at the end.

**Usage with no project name shows as "unknown", not "Old records (totals only)".** When Codex can't find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`. The report treated every `unknown` project as old total-only history. The report and its filter now check whether a row came from the old total-only ledger. Only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)"; current usage with no project shows as "unknown".

**Generating a report no longer erases days that background updates just saved to the year ledger.** The year ledger was protected only by a lock inside a single process. When the report ran in a separate process, the report and the background updates could write the ledger at the same time, and one write could erase days the other had just saved or backfilled. usage now creates a lock file next to `year_ledger.json`, so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write the ledger. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, usage skips this update and tries again later. It never writes without the lock.

**usage no longer sends a Muse "restored" notification just because the reset time passed.** For Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, usage sends nothing when the reset time passes; it waits for a new reading. For Muse, it treated the 0% shown after the reset as a real reading. So when Muse sat idle and was not checked again, usage sent a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows. usage now handles Muse the same way as the other tools.

**Quota-aware mode no longer repeats a warning when the reset estimate moves earlier.** If the estimated reset time moved more than ten minutes earlier, usage treated it as a new window and sent the same warning again. This happened, for example, when Antigravity switched between its two quota sources. Now, as long as your usage stays at the level you were already warned about, you won't get the warning again, whichever way the estimate moves.

**Turning on the status line with only the Grok CLI installed no longer reports a failure.** usage installed the Grok status line, but the switch still showed an error because it found neither Claude Code nor Codex. It now reports success once the Grok status line is set up.

**Muse readings use the time Muse's server checked the quota.** When usage read an old allowance again, the reading could look new. The Muse card and the status line now use the server's check time to decide on the stale notice and to show the reading's age.

**Quota-aware mode shows how old a reused Claude Code reading is.** When the status line redrew, an old reading could look current. usage now records a separate reading time for each quota window, so a fresh five-hour reading no longer shows the weekly reading's age. The status line hook updates to 1.21 and the quota-aware hook to 1.19.
**Repairing the resume hook keeps newer scripts.** When the prompt file goes missing, usage restores it and leaves a newer installed script in place.

**All-time reports include earlier Claude Code activity.** The report used to start on the first day with token usage, so it left out earlier days that had activity but no token records. It now starts on the earliest day with either, and the date picker can select that day.

**A Codex quota rejection now applies only to its own quota.** When a dedicated quota such as Codex Spark was rejected more recently than the general Codex quota, usage hid the general rejection and showed the general window below 100%. usage now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window.

**New Codex models are announced only once.** If a model showed up in usage logs first, usage announced it, then announced it again in the same conversation when the model later appeared in the Codex model list. usage now reuses the first record and keeps its first-seen time.

**GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra have prices when offline.** When the price table could not be downloaded, usage counted Codex's new GPT-6.2 models at $0. The built-in fallback price table now includes them: Sol $2 / $10 and Astra $8 / $40 per million input / output tokens.

**Report exports are named after the dates they cover.** HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the day you exported them. If you opened a filtered export months later, you couldn't tell from the file name which period it covered. Files are now named like `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`. Reports without a date picker still use the export date. An exported HTML report reopens at the same dates.

**Token Saver's rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies.** Articles, posts, and slides you ask Claude to write no longer have to follow them. If you ask for a post full of analogies, you no longer run into a conflict with Token Saver.

**Token Saver no longer allows a short reply to call unverified work done.** After Claude edits files or runs commands, its reply now says what it verified, and says plainly when work is untested or only partly done. Claude writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. Teaching rules in your CLAUDE.md, a request for an analogy, or saying you don't follow now take priority over keeping replies short. The rule against made-up abbreviations also no longer says that abbreviations save no tokens, because there was no evidence for that.

title.zh-TW: 報表與年度帳本的歷史紀錄更準確
title.en: More accurate history in reports and the year ledger

body.zh-TW:
翻開歷史報表核對用量，現在不用擔心數字卡在舊紀錄或被覆蓋。

Antigravity 計數修正前存下的舊日子，token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）總數偏高，過去因為快照只在新數字不小於舊紀錄時才替換而換不進去。現在快照會記下計數版次，只要當天所有工作階段與其他工具紀錄還在本機，就換成修正數字。年度帳本等快照換好才更新，報表也不再補回舊差額。

報表與背景更新在不同行程同時寫入 `year_ledger.json` 時，過去會互相蓋掉剛存下或補回的日子。現在帳本旁會建鎖檔，一次只讓一個行程讀取、合併並寫回。別的行程佔鎖超過 10 秒就跳過等下次補，沒拿到鎖不寫入。

「全部」報表過去從有 token 用量的第一天起算，漏掉更早只有活躍紀錄的日子。現在改從最早有用量或活躍紀錄那天開始，日期篩選器也選得到。
body.en:
When checking past usage in historical reports, you no longer have to worry about numbers getting stuck on old records or overwritten.

Old Antigravity days saved before the counting fix had inflated token (text units AI processes and bills by) totals, which could not be replaced before because the snapshot only swapped in a new number when it was at least as large as the old one. Now the snapshot records the counting version and swaps in the corrected number as long as all sessions and other tool records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger waits until the snapshot finishes replacing the day before updating, and reports no longer add back the old difference.

When a report and a background update ran in separate processes and wrote to `year_ledger.json` at the same time, they could overwrite days the other had just saved or backfilled. Now a lock file is created next to the ledger so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write it back. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, this update is skipped for later, and nothing is written without the lock.

The "All-time" report used to start from the first day with token usage, leaving out earlier days that only had activity records. It now starts from the earliest day with either usage or activity records, and the date picker can select that day too.

items.original:
**Antigravity days in the snapshot now show the corrected token totals.** Before this fix, the daily snapshot replaced a saved day only if the new total was at least as large. Antigravity days saved before the token-counting fix were too high, so the smaller corrected totals never replaced them, in reports or in the snapshot file. The snapshot now records which counting version produced each day. It replaces an old Antigravity day only when every session and every other tool's records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger updates that day only after the snapshot has replaced it, and reports no longer add the old difference back from the ledger.
**Generating a report no longer erases days that background updates just saved to the year ledger.** The year ledger was protected only by a lock inside a single process. When the report ran in a separate process, the report and the background updates could write the ledger at the same time, and one write could erase days the other had just saved or backfilled. usage now creates a lock file next to `year_ledger.json`, so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write the ledger. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, usage skips this update and tries again later. It never writes without the lock.
**All-time reports include earlier Claude Code activity.** The report used to start on the first day with token usage, so it left out earlier days that had activity but no token records. It now starts on the earliest day with either, and the date picker can select that day.

title.zh-TW: 專案分類與報表匯出檔名更清楚
title.en: Clearer project labels and report export file names

body.zh-TW:
匯出專案排行或翻找幾個月前的報表檔案，標籤和檔名常讓人一頭霧水。

匯出專案 CSV 過去先取前 10 名才挑出只剩總數的舊紀錄，第 10 名專案會被擠掉。現在比照報表畫面先挑出舊紀錄，列在最後一列，再取前 10 名專案。

Codex 找不到工作階段的工作資料夾時，會把專案記成 `unknown`，過去報表一律當成舊紀錄。現在報表和網頁篩選器會檢查資料是否來自舊帳本，是才標成「舊紀錄（只剩總數）」，其餘無名稱的用量顯示「未知」。

HTML、CSV 和 PNG 匯出檔過去用匯出當天命名，隔幾個月重開看不出資料期間。現在改用涵蓋日期命名，像 `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`，無日期篩選器的報表仍用匯出日。匯出的 HTML 重開時也會停在同一段日期。
body.en:
Exporting project rankings or digging up report files from months ago used to leave you guessing at labels and file names.

Project CSV exports used to take the top 10 rows before setting aside old total-only records, which pushed out the 10th project. Now, matching the report view, old records are set aside first and placed in the last row before taking the top 10 projects.

When Codex cannot find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`, which reports used to treat as old records across the board. Now the report and web filter check whether the data came from the old ledger: only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)", while other unnamed usage shows as "unknown".

HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the export date, making it hard to tell which period they covered when reopened months later. They are now named after the covered dates, such as `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`, while reports without a date picker still use the export date. Reopening an exported HTML file also stays on those same dates.

items.original:
**CSV exports no longer drop the 10th project when old total-only records exist.** The project CSV export took the top 10 rows first and set aside old total-only records second. Those records took one of the 10 places, so the 10th project was left out. The export now sets aside old total-only records first and then takes the top 10 projects, the same way the report chart does. The old records get their own row at the end.
**Usage with no project name shows as "unknown", not "Old records (totals only)".** When Codex can't find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`. The report treated every `unknown` project as old total-only history. The report and its filter now check whether a row came from the old total-only ledger. Only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)"; current usage with no project shows as "unknown".
**Report exports are named after the dates they cover.** HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the day you exported them. If you opened a filtered export months later, you couldn't tell from the file name which period it covered. Files are now named like `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`. Reports without a date picker still use the export date. An exported HTML report reopens at the same dates.

title.zh-TW: 額度讀數時效與提醒不再誤報
title.en: Accurate quota reading ages and no more false alerts

body.zh-TW:
看終端機底下的狀態列與額度提示，讀數新舊和警告現在不再亂跳。

Muse 過重置時間若沒重讀，過去把 0% 當真在 macOS 與 Windows 跳「已恢復」通知，現在改等新讀數。

Muse 卡片與狀態列改用伺服器查額度時間判斷過期與年齡，重讀舊額度不再像剛查的。

重置估計提前超過 10 分鐘時（如切換額度來源），只要用量停在已警告程度，額度感知模式就不重複警告。

Claude Code 替各時段分開記讀取時間，五小時額度不再顯示週額度舊時間。狀態列 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）升到 1.21，額度感知為 1.19。

Codex 替各額度保留最新拒絕只套用到對應時段，Codex Spark 較晚被拒時，不再藏起一般額度拒絕。
body.en:
Checking the status line at the bottom of your terminal and quota prompts, reading ages and warnings no longer jump around.

When Muse passed its reset time without a fresh reading, it used to treat 0% as real and trigger a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows; it now waits for a new reading.

The Muse card and status line now use the server's quota check time to judge staleness and age, so re-reading an old quota no longer looks freshly checked.

When the reset estimate moves earlier by more than 10 minutes (such as when switching quota sources), quota-aware mode no longer repeats the warning as long as usage stays at an already-warned level.

Claude Code now records a separate reading time for each window, so the five-hour quota no longer shows the weekly quota's old timestamp. The status line hook (a small program triggered by specific events) updates to 1.21, and quota-aware updates to 1.19.

Codex now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window, so a newer Codex Spark rejection no longer hides a general quota rejection.

items.original:
**usage no longer sends a Muse "restored" notification just because the reset time passed.** For Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, usage sends nothing when the reset time passes; it waits for a new reading. For Muse, it treated the 0% shown after the reset as a real reading. So when Muse sat idle and was not checked again, usage sent a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows. usage now handles Muse the same way as the other tools.
**Quota-aware mode no longer repeats a warning when the reset estimate moves earlier.** If the estimated reset time moved more than ten minutes earlier, usage treated it as a new window and sent the same warning again. This happened, for example, when Antigravity switched between its two quota sources. Now, as long as your usage stays at the level you were already warned about, you won't get the warning again, whichever way the estimate moves.
**Muse readings use the time Muse's server checked the quota.** When usage read an old allowance again, the reading could look new. The Muse card and the status line now use the server's check time to decide on the stale notice and to show the reading's age.
**Quota-aware mode shows how old a reused Claude Code reading is.** When the status line redrew, an old reading could look current. usage now records a separate reading time for each quota window, so a fresh five-hour reading no longer shows the weekly reading's age. The status line hook updates to 1.21 and the quota-aware hook to 1.19.
**A Codex quota rejection now applies only to its own quota.** When a dedicated quota such as Codex Spark was rejected more recently than the general Codex quota, usage hid the general rejection and showed the general window below 100%. usage now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window.

title.zh-TW: 只裝 Grok CLI 開啟狀態列不再報錯
title.en: No error when enabling the status line with only Grok CLI installed

body.zh-TW: 電腦裡只裝了 Grok CLI，開關狀態列卻一直跳出失敗訊息？Grok 狀態列當時已經裝好了，只是 usage 找不到 Claude Code 或 Codex 就跟著回報錯誤。現在只要 Grok 狀態列設定完成，就會回報成功。
body.en: Have only the Grok CLI installed and keep getting a failure message when toggling the status line? The Grok status line was actually already installed, but usage reported an error because it could not find Claude Code or Codex. Now it reports success once the Grok status line is set up.

items.original: **Turning on the status line with only the Grok CLI installed no longer reports a failure.** usage installed the Grok status line, but the switch still showed an error because it found neither Claude Code nor Codex. It now reports success once the Grok status line is set up.

title.zh-TW: 修復續談 hook 會保留較新的腳本
title.en: Repairing the resume hook keeps newer scripts

body.zh-TW: 續談用的提示檔不見了，想跑修復卻怕蓋掉後來裝好的新版程式。現在修復續談 hook 時，usage 只會把遺失的提示檔補回來，已安裝的較新腳本會原封不動留在原地。
body.en: If your resume prompt file went missing, you might hesitate to run a repair for fear of overwriting a newer script installed later. Now when repairing the resume hook, usage only restores the missing prompt file and leaves any newer installed script untouched.

items.original: **Repairing the resume hook keeps newer scripts.** When the prompt file goes missing, usage restores it and leaves a newer installed script in place.

title.zh-TW: 新的 Codex 模型只會公告一次
title.en: New Codex models are announced only once

body.zh-TW: 同一個對話裡，某個模型先出現在用量紀錄、後來又進到 Codex 模型清單，過去 usage 總共發出兩次通知。現在 usage 會沿用第一次的紀錄並保留首次出現的時間，不再重複公告。
body.en: Within the same conversation, if a model appeared in usage logs first and later showed up in the Codex model list, usage used to send two notifications. Now usage reuses the first record and keeps its first-seen time instead of announcing it again.

items.original: **New Codex models are announced only once.** If a model showed up in usage logs first, usage announced it, then announced it again in the same conversation when the model later appeared in the Codex model list. usage now reuses the first record and keeps its first-seen time.

title.zh-TW: GPT-6.2 Sol 與 Astra 離線也有價
title.en: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra have offline pricing

body.zh-TW: 無法下載價目表時，Codex 新的 GPT-6.2 模型花費過去會被算成 $0。現在內建的備援價目表已經收錄它們的單價，斷線也能照常計費：Sol 每百萬 token 輸入 $2、輸出 $10，Astra 則是輸入 $8、輸出 $40。
body.en: When the price table could not be downloaded, Codex's new GPT-6.2 models used to be counted at $0. The built-in fallback price table now includes their rates so billing still works offline: Sol is $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, while Astra is $8 input and $40 output.

items.original: **GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra have prices when offline.** When the price table could not be downloaded, usage counted Codex's new GPT-6.2 models at $0. The built-in fallback price table now includes them: Sol $2 / $10 and Astra $8 / $40 per million input / output tokens.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式不限制創作且誠實交代驗證
title.en: Token Saver unblocks creative writing and reports verification honestly

body.zh-TW:
開啟精簡模式省字數，過去常連帶綁住創作內容或讓回覆過度簡略。

「不用比喻、表情符號、裝飾性表格」這幾條規定現在只管 Claude 自己的回覆。你請它寫的文章、貼文或簡報不用遵守，要它寫一篇滿是比喻的貼文也不會再跟精簡模式衝突。

改檔或跑指令後，短回覆不能再把沒驗證的事說成做完了。Claude 現在會交代驗證了什麼，沒測過或只做一部分會直說，也會把沒驗證的假設與還沒解決的風險寫完整。如果你的 `CLAUDE.md` 有教學規則、你要求用比喻或說看不懂，這些都優先於精簡；「不要自創縮寫」也拿掉了「縮寫省不到 token」這句沒有證據的說法。

⟦就像請秘書平時用條列快報進度，他自己的工作匯報會力求精短、沒確認完的事也老實標出來，但替你代筆的活動致詞稿仍會保留比喻和圖表。⟧
body.en:
Turning on Token Saver to save words used to restrict creative writing as well or make replies overly terse.

The rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies. Articles, posts, or slides you ask it to write do not have to follow them, so asking for a post full of analogies will no longer conflict with Token Saver.

After editing files or running commands, short replies can no longer claim unverified work is done. Claude now states what it verified, says plainly when something is untested or only partly done, and writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. If your `CLAUDE.md` has teaching rules, or if you ask for analogies or say you do not follow, those take priority over brevity; the rule against made-up abbreviations also drops the unsupported claim that abbreviations save no tokens.

⟦Think of a secretary who normally gives you bullet-point progress updates: his own work reports stay brief and flag anything unverified, while the event speeches he drafts for you still keep their analogies and charts.⟧

items.original:
**Token Saver's rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies.** Articles, posts, and slides you ask Claude to write no longer have to follow them. If you ask for a post full of analogies, you no longer run into a conflict with Token Saver.
**Token Saver no longer allows a short reply to call unverified work done.** After Claude edits files or runs commands, its reply now says what it verified, and says plainly when work is untested or only partly done. Claude writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. Teaching rules in your CLAUDE.md, a request for an analogy, or saying you don't follow now take priority over keeping replies short. The rule against made-up abbreviations also no longer says that abbreviations save no tokens, because there was no evidence for that.

## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: 刪除私有或內部儲存庫前會再確認 fork
title.en: Confirming forks again before deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧
